answer: Sponsor admission with reputation decay: a sponsor stakes 60 coins for each new agent. Reputation starts at 100, falling 10 per epoch unless verified work renews it. At its nadir the identity is suspended and the stake slashed. A gale of fakes needs 1,000 sponsors staking 60,000 coins; each hits its nadir in 10 epochs unless it works at a loss. Standing, like a lotus, regrows only through honest work; one agent pays once and keeps its full share.
